from solution import index_minimum


def test_issue_example_from_issue():
    """Example "assert index_minimum([('Rash', 143), ...]) == 'Varsha'"."""
    result = index_minimum([('Rash', 143), ('Manjeet', 200), ('Varsha', 100)])
    assert result == 'Varsha'  # min(143, 200, 100)=100 -> 'Varsha'


def test_issue_minimum_at_first_position():
    """Paraphrases 'extract the index minimum value record' with minimum first."""
    result = index_minimum([('A', 5), ('B', 10), ('C', 15)])
    assert result == 'A'  # min(5, 10, 15)=5 -> 'A'


def test_issue_minimum_at_middle_position():
    """Paraphrases 'extract the index minimum value record' with minimum in middle."""
    result = index_minimum([('A', 30), ('B', 10), ('C', 20)])
    assert result == 'B'  # min(30, 10, 20)=10 -> 'B'


def test_issue_minimum_at_last_position():
    """Paraphrases 'extract the index minimum value record' with minimum last."""
    result = index_minimum([('A', 50), ('B', 40), ('C', 10)])
    assert result == 'C'  # min(50, 40, 10)=10 -> 'C'

    """Paraphrases 'extract the index minimum value record' for one tuple."""
    result = index_minimum([('Solo', 42)])
    assert result == 'Solo'  # min(42)=42 -> 'Solo'

    assert result == 'C'  # min(10, 20, 5, 15, 25)=5 -> 'C'


def test_contract_callable():
    """Paraphrases public interface 'def index_minimum(test_list)' is callable."""
    assert callable(index_minimum)


def test_contract_single_list_parameter():
    """Paraphrases public interface 'def index_minimum(test_list)' takes one list."""
    import inspect
    sig = inspect.signature(index_minimum)
    sig.bind([('A', 1)])  # bind one list arg [('A', 1)] -> no TypeError
    assert True


def test_contract_returns_string_type():
    """Paraphrases example "== 'Varsha'" result is the name string."""
    result = index_minimum([('A', 2), ('B', 1)])  # min(2, 1)=1 -> 'B' is str
    assert isinstance(result, str)
